tasks.label: iOS: List Devices and Simulators
tasks.command:
xcrun devicectl list devices; echo '
--- Simulators ---'; xcrun simctl list devices available | head -80

tasks.label: iOS: Build Simulator
tasks.command: xcodebuild build -project Pantree.xcodeproj -scheme Pantree -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro,OS=26.2'

tasks.label: iOS: Test Simulator
tasks.command: xcodebuild test -project Pantree.xcodeproj -scheme Pantree -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro,OS=26.2'
